plainName: Getting up, C-cuts and glides, three zones
description: Three first-skating stations for early in the season. Groups move to the next zone on the whistle: getting up off the ice, C-cut pushes, and two-foot then one-foot glides.
steps: A: get up into ready stance, then skate to the blue line.
B: glide on one foot and push C-cuts with the other.
C: a few strides, then glide on two feet, then one.
cues: Push a C, bring it home.

focus.why: Getting up, stance, push and glide.
Falling and getting up is a game.

zones.name: Get up!
zones.how: Lie on your back. On the whistle, roll over, get to your knees and stand up in ready stance. Then a few strides, drop to your knees, up again, skate to the blue line.

zones.name: C-cuts
zones.how: Glide on one foot and push C shapes with the other, three or four times. Then switch feet.
zones.cue: Push a C, bring it home.

zones.name: Glide statues
zones.how: A few strides, then glide on two feet in ready stance like a statue. Then try one foot.

source.label: Hockey Canada U7 Phase I Lesson 2 · 1.1.02, 1.4.01, 1.1.06–1.1.07
source.note: The source offers four, two or six stations. We kept three that fit the half-ice zones; Fall Down, Simon Says and T-push are left for other plans.
